Market today: The market's mood is mixed, with conflicting signals on bond yields. While Treasury buybacks aim to lower yields, actual 30-year yields hit a 19-year high, a major headwind for your growth-heavy tech and chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-49.27%) and SPAL (-36.54%) are both leveraged ETFs with significant losses, amplified by margin. SPAL is a brand-new, very volatile IPO. SMH (-10.47%) is also down and needs attention at its stop.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields; their direction will heavily influence your portfolio. Also, watch for any follow-through on positive chip sector news.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged, losing positions and respect your stops, especially with yield volatility.
plays: SOXL and SPAL are leveraged and deeply in the red; consider trimming or exiting to reduce margin risk.
SMH is nearing its stop at 540; respect that level to protect capital.
Consider MU for a new buy if you want chip exposure, given the SK Hynix news and its scanner setup: entry 936.21-934.35, stop 927.43.
